Top-row 8s at alternating columns; repeated UP tests under aligned 8s have been non-productive, so 8 likely blocked/decorative or needs another condition. Stronger route hypothesis: descend toward the horizontal wall band on macro row 8, which has traversable 10 openings at macro cols 1 and 6; lower-right 8 may be the real target later. Current local read: player is on macro row 4 around macro col 1, one row above the wall band, so move RIGHT toward the more promising opening at macro col 6 before trying DOWN.
